topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I noticed something peculiar about my neighbor recently. It started with a few small things, subtle hints of affluence that most wouldn't catch. The sleek, unmarked car that would occasionally pull up, the discreet yet high-end landscaping changes to their yard. Then, there was the evening I glimpsed a glimpse of what could only be described as an art collection, through a briefly open window. It’s fascinating, really, how some people choose to keep such things to themselves. I can appreciate the privacy; it’s a respect I intend to maintain. It’s their life, after all, and how they choose to live it is their business.
